_doc: Things that stand on supports and come down when a support goes (design/world/spells-and-environment-spec.md §6.4; build item N-4.3). maps: per map, each structure's id, name, rect [x, y, w, h] (sim px: what it falls on), h (metres up: the deck the view draws), and supports [[x, y], ...]: a prop of kind `post` stands at each. Break a post (Impact at its grade, or burn it to ash) and the structure collapses after telegraph_s (never less than the fair-dodge delay for its size): `impact` grade and `damage` to everyone under it, the same Impact on the props there, and its cells become rubble. rubble: a ground cell state; everyone on it moves rubble_slow slower, and an Impact at clear_grade or more on it clears it. Structures stand again only when you wake (a new life).
